text:
sara: Noticing elevated p95 in eu-dedicated canary, deploy-bot flagged it.

deploy-bot: alert: canary p95 = 710ms (+220ms vs baseline) over 6m; client_error_rate +2.8%. Action suggested: PAUSE rollout and run targeted probe. auto-rollback: disabled (maintenance window).

kevin: Did the rollout include the new kernel toggle for quantized matmul?

maria: Yes  kernel toggle + cache hotfix. Local bench looked fine, no multi-az canary run yet.

ops_oncall: Can we get diffs between canary bundle and previous release? If kernel path is culprit we may need manual rollback.

jamal: Running telemetry diff: `redwood telemetry diff --since 12m --pool eu-dedicated --metrics p95,errors` will post numbers.

jamal: results:
```
p95_canary: 710ms
p95_prev: 470ms
error_rate_canary: 1.8%
error_rate_prev: 0.6%
```

maria: p95 regression is clear. Any user-facing 5xx spikes in app logs?

kevin: grep shows several `kv_cache_miss` warnings and one `cuda_sync_timeout` in worker-2 on v2.4.0.

sara: Options: A) Partial rollback (50% traffic to v2.3.8), keep canary pinned. B) Cherry-pick revert of kernel toggle and redeploy canary. Given auto-rollback is suppressed, prefer manual action.

ops_oncall: Recommend partial 50% split to limit impact, then targeted revert on canary if signal persists.

deploy-bot: command hints:
- split traffic: `redwood traffic set --pool eu-dedicated --route default --split 50:50 --to v2.3.8,v2.4.0`
- rollback pool: `redwood rollback --pool eu-dedicated --to v2.3.8`
- pin canary: `redwood pin --instance canary-eu --version v2.4.0`

maria: We'll need to notify the three early-access enterprise customers on eu-dedicated.

sara: Decision: apply 50% rollback to v2.3.8, pin canary, monitor 30m. @jamal apply the traffic split and post monitor link.

jamal: Executing: `redwood traffic set --pool eu-dedicated --route default --split 50:50 --to v2.3.8,v2.4.0` now.

deploy-bot: action started (requested by jamal). rollout id: r-616161-01

jamal: applied. live monitor: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/eu-dedicated/r-616161-01

kevin: I'll tail for `cuda_sync_timeout` and `kv_cache_miss` across versions to see concentration.

ops_oncall: Notifying SRE and CS: `@sre-team` `@cs-eu`  partial rollback applied, canary pinned, monitoring. ETA 30m.

maria: Draft to customers: "We observed a latency regression in the canary; weve partially rolled back to reduce impact. No data loss expected. Update in 30m." Approve to send?

sara: Send it, include monitor link and ops contact.

jamal: +10m update: overall p95 dropped to ~505ms, error-rate ~0.7%. v2.3.8 p95 490ms, v2.4.0 still ~710ms.

kevin: Signal points to v2.4.0 runtime path. Prepare a targeted revert of kernel toggle and redeploy canary rather than full rollback.

maria: Opening cherry-pick revert PR now and will run quick e2e on canary when CI passes.

sara: Checklist:
- [x] Partial traffic rollback executed
- [x] Customers notified
- [x] Live monitor shared
- [ ] Cherry-pick revert PR and canary redeploy
- [ ] Post-mortem if unresolved in 2h

maria: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/4329. CI running.

deploy-bot: canary redeploy scheduled on PR merge; prometheus health checks will gate promotion. auto-rollback remains suppressed for this maintenance window.

jamal: Monitoring every 5m for 30m, will post updates.

ops_oncall: At +30m: p95 stabilized at ~485ms overall. v2.4.0 still shows tail but errors reduced. Keeping 50/50 split until revert validated.

sara: Closing active escalation. Reopen if metric regressions recur. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
